purpose: Read-only replacement for protected Python EmitterHandles access. Root executes one request at a time under the existing editor guard.
schema_source: Hayba list_tool_categories/get_tool_signature, 2026-10-01; native ObjectGetProperty explicitly includes non-editable reflected properties when names are supplied.
continuation: Stop on an error or an empty EmitterHandles property; preserve the response. Do not simulate, duplicate, activate or modify.
The explicit native property read returns Unreal ExportText, not parsed JSON structs. Obtain each VersionedInstance.Emitter or StatelessEmitter subobject path verbatim from that response.

For an observed regular NiagaraEmitter path, call object_get_property with that exact path and names:[VersionData]. Match its Version.VersionGuid to VersionedInstance.Version. Record SimTarget, bLocalSpace, AllocationMode, PreAllocationCount and RendererProperties.

For each observed renderer UObject path, call object_get_property with that exact path and names:[Material,MaterialUserParamBinding,SourceMode,Alignment,FacingMode,SubImageSize,bSubImageBlend,bEnableCameraDistanceCulling,bCastShadows]. A material user binding may override Material.
If ExportText omits required subobjects, report that boundary; do not invent paths or select a template based on its name. Stateless emitters require their separate reflected schema before use.
